notes: Original title and DOI verified in full primary PDF available through the web tool; direct repository downloads returned 403. Replication report title, team, SCORE ID and cited original match the assigned reference; yd9bg is a file, not a node, under project 697dv. The original requested es_type ser_method is not a printed metric; retained printed standardized beta. Replication requested Cohen's f^2 is not printed in this report. A unique replication outcome cannot be selected from the empty locator, so replication es and p are null, rather than arbitrarily taking the first table. Printed candidate smoking tests: Table 1 negative distress standardized Beta .0054913499723, t .1947514315708, Sig. .8456167629028; Table 2 positive distress Beta .0246228540727, t .8742022994525, Sig. .3821631203854; Table 3 depressive distress Beta .0148543505843, t .5285074658139, Sig. .5972337804787. These are distinct tests, not a single effect. The report explicitly replaces the original distress outcome with three subscale outcomes and omits nationality and education covariates; target_match remains unknown for the unspecified assigned replication test. The original focal claim is independently identifiable from the report and verified in the original Table 2.
